journey.name: Demo: create a mask
journey.description: In the demo list, the New mask form accepts a prefix, updates the preview and creates a mask locally. Nothing is sent to Fastmail.

actions.action: Verify that the heading "Masked", the "Demo mode" banner and a "New mask" button are visible
Verify that a menu with "Random mask" and "New mask" entries is visible
Tap the "New mask" entry in the menu
Verify that the screen titled "New mask" shows a "Preview" of "random.xyzw@fastmail.com" and fields "Prefix", "Domain", "Note" and "URL"
Verify that the "Preview" now starts with "journey_test"
Press the system Back key to close the on-screen keyboard
Verify that a confirmation mentioning "journey_test" is shown or the list shows an address starting with "journey_test"
